correctness.rationale: For K_(2m) with m prescribed vertex pairs, all conductances variable, matching price t>0 and budget B>0, group symmetrization plus concavity yields symmetric eigenvalues 2ma and (2m-2)a+2b and the exact optimum 2B/(2m-2+t) for t<=2, B/m for t>=2. When t<2 the orbit-average of PSD slack L-lambda P vanishes, forcing every optimizer to be the uniform Laplacian. For t>=2, m antisymmetric pair vectors give m lambda2<=B-(t-2)sum d_i; equality implies all four edges between pair i and pair j have one common c_ij, and exactly 2d_i+2sum c_ij=B/m, 2lambda2(L_c)>=B/m, (t-2)sum d_i=0. At t>2 degree equations have affine dimension m(m-3)/2 for m>=3 (m=2 separately) and a strict interior spectral witness; at t=2 dimension m(m-1)/2. Independent matrix tests for 60 parameter sets m2..7 and 480 asymmetric feasible assignments confirmed eigenvalue value/equality inequalities (max roundoff 1.22e-15). Analytic PSD equality and incidence ranks, not random testing, prove all parameters.
